title: ADA Subject — tabular component
description: The shape carried by the ~50 inferred schemas describing a delimited-text component: countRows and countColumns (50 schemas each), columns (49) and headerRowCount (43). Nothing is required, because the four keys do not co-occur in every one of those schemas; a consuming type block requires what its own subjects all carry.

items.title: ADA Subject — one column of a tabular component
items.description: One item of a `columns` array. Measured across the 49 inferred schemas that carry `columns`: 14 distinct item shapes, every one a SUBSET of the nine keys below, with colNum and fieldDescription present in all 14. So this is one shape with optional keys, not fourteen shapes — verified by set containment, not assumed.

colNum.description: 1-based position of the column in the file. Integer in all 49 schemas, with no variants. Maps to cdif:index.

fieldType.description: Physical data type as ADA records it. Maps to cdif:physicalDataType.
